dialogSubtitle: Just a few quick steps to get everything ready for immersive language learning.

models.title: Offline Speech & Transcription Models
models.desc: DashPlayer features built-in local offline models for natural pronunciation and speech recognition without an internet connection.
models.ttsDesc: Used for offline high-fidelity speech synthesis during word lookup and vocabulary study.
models.transcriptionDesc: Used for one-click automatic transcription and bilingual alignment directly on your device.
models.downloadNote: Tip: Downloads support resumption. If your network is slow, you can also download them later in Settings → Service Credentials.

translation.title: Configure Translation & LLM
translation.desc: Select your AI engine and set up keys or download models directly:
translation.optionLocalDesc: Runs completely on your device without internet access or API keys, private and free.
translation.optionOpenAiDesc: Connect to cloud LLMs for high-accuracy translation and deep linguistic analysis.
translation.localModelDesc: Recommended for daily use, high quality offline subtitle translation and lookup (~1.28 GB).
translation.openaiKeyPlaceholder: Enter API Key starting with sk-
translation.cloudSetupTip: Tip: You can change models or configure custom prompt styles in Settings anytime.

tutorial.title: How to Open Videos & Subtitles
tutorial.desc: Master the two most convenient ways to import media and start learning:
tutorial.method1Desc: Click 'Open Folder' on the home page and select a directory containing your videos and subtitles. DashPlayer will automatically link them.
tutorial.method1Tip: 💡 Tip: Keep video and subtitle files in the same folder with matching names, e.g. movie.mp4 and movie.srt.
tutorial.method2Title: Method 2: Multi-select Video and Subtitle Files
tutorial.method2Desc: Click 'Open File', and in the system file picker dialog, hold Ctrl / Command to select both the video file (.mp4/.mkv, etc.) and subtitle file (.srt/.vtt, etc.) together.
tutorial.method2Tip: 💡 Tip: Selecting both files at once automatically binds the subtitles and loads the player.
